results.title: Rebellion in Niger: who are the MPLJ, the FPL and the CFLN? – Sahel Watch
results.snippet:
### The MPLJ, the most active actor, focused on oil

Created in 2024 by Moussa Kounaï following a split with the FPL, the MPLJ is today the most offensive movement. Its strategy is economic: to strike the junta’s main source of revenue. “Destroying the pipeline means destroying Tiani,” its leader summed up in an interview with Jeune Afrique in January 2026.
